title: Answer: information is form felt in prehension

statements.text: The scheme has no theory of information as such. Segall reads prehension as information processing carried out as feeling, so that information is always experiential, and Hunt and Schooler tie the combination of consciousness to faster energy and information flows in shared resonance.

sources.quote: Prehension is akin to the ‘information processing’ of computationalists
information processing is an experiential process, with the intensity of experience depending on the degree of integration of prehended data achieved by any given society of occasions
